content: Starting 2025, rayonny koeffitsient (regional coefficient) and severnaya nadbavka (northern allowance) form a SEPARATE NDFL tax base from regular salary (own progressive thresholds, distinct from the main 5-step scale). FNS clarified June 2025 that average-earnings-based payments (e.g. vacation pay, business trip per diems calculated off average salary) do NOT use this special 2-tier northern scale and instead fall under the main 5-step scale. Rules for regional coefficient/northern allowance NDFL changed again for 2026 (law 425-FZ, Nov 2025) - this area is actively evolving and should be treated as a known future-scope gap for v1 (which targets standard non-northern salaries).
